closure_distance_reason: Shared-path invariants are exact gradients and add no coupling; the exact component exclusions are finite and the parametric construction supplies genuine all-prime single cycles but no bicyclic core.
new_results: For every mixed-valuation oriented path, sum(p-q)=v-u and product f_A(p)/f_A(q)=v/u; shared-path subtraction is tautological.
Exact full-component expansion from all 20,516 degree>=3 vertices <=2,000,000 yields 18,539 components, only three unicyclic and none bicyclic.
The increasing-orientation identity mu=1-s+sum_(d+>=2)(d+-1) gives an independent audit of 3,731 upward-branch seeds, with six unicyclic and no bicyclic component.
A parametric all-prime parallel-cycle construction follows from (hp-B)(hq-B)=cB^2-h; label conflict is exactly k|pq.

A complete search of 50,822 factor pairs in the stated family, with all factor bases and 159 distinct cycle primes proved prime by PARI/GP, finds 41 conflict-free all-prime single cycles, two with h>1, no shared endpoints, and no bicyclic core among twelve exactly closed small components.
